page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no margin notes; page number at the head centred above the column.

main_text.head: LI.
main_text.p: Idem arcus, coronæ, pareliorum, virgarum: quia nebu-la seu nubes: à cuius varietate varietas est reflexionis: quæ efficiens eorum causa est.
main_text.head: LII.
main_text.p: Nec aliter de Ventis, fluminibus, terræ motibus, toni-truis, fulminibus, ceterisque sentiendum est.
main_text.head: LIII.
main_text.p: Etsi enim Ventus forte simplex halitus est: concretioni-tamen & ipse affectio est.
main_text.head: LIV.
main_text.p: Nam aliud simplex & ascendens halitus est, qui Ventorum materia est: aliud affectio & forma Venti, quæ in fluxione consistit: aliud subiectum, cuius hæc affectio est.
main_text.head: LV.
main_text.p: Siccus igitur halitus etiam hic cum aere, quantumuis forte leuiter, concrescit: cuius concretionis affectio Ventus fit, cùm halitus motione cæli fluere incipit.
main_text.head: LVI.
main_text.p: Ita fontium, fluuiorum, terræ-motus, subiectum concretum corpus est: fontium quidem & fluminum terra, quà multum vaporis, terræ-motus, quà multum ficci halitus, continet: qui non ipsius terræ-motus, vt multi perperam docent, sed Spiritus intra terram fluentis, materia est, qui efficiens terræ-motus causa est.
main_text.head: LXVII.
main_text.p: Non minus euidens, tonitrui, procellæ, typhonis, præ-teris, fulminis, subiectum concretum corpus esse.
main_text.head: LVIII.
main_text.p: Nubes enim est: sed alia tonitrui, alia ceterorum.
main_text.head: LIX.
main_text.p: Subiectum enim procellæ, typhonis, præsteris, fulminis, illill

page.notes: Printed numerals LXVII and LVIII are as printed (the sequence reads LVI, LXVII, LVIII, LIX; LXVII is probably LVII). "pareliorum" and "præ-teris" and "præsteris" are as printed. The last word on the page, "ill", is a catchword-like fragment at the lower right, not a full word; it is shown as catchword. Line "concretioni-tamen" has a column-edge break and is transcribed as printed. Tears and staining at top-left are not transcribed.
